turns.text: How can users log in to a PHR app?

must_contain: A user signs in by any of four routes, and every route is mandatory: mobile number, ABHA address, ABHA number and Aadhaar number
Mobile number is validated by mobile OTP, an address by password or mobile OTP, the ABHA number by ABHA OTP or Aadhaar OTP, and the Aadhaar number by Aadhaar OTP
Every OTP route returns the ABHA addresses linked to that identifier, and the user picks the one to sign in as
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 12: 'The response seems fine, but the language could be more user-friendly.' Verdict group: language and register. The facts were accepted; the wording was written for an integrator.
